context_abs: Background: This time series represents a measure of industrial production. Scenario: Suppose a global economic downturn occurs from 1983-12-31 00:00:00 onwards, resulting in reduced demand for industrial goods and a subsequent decline in production levels by around 10% compared to the previous year. This downturn is expected to persist over the forecast horizon, leading to a steady decrease in production values. The impact of this economic downturn on future values will be a sustained decline, with production levels expected to be around 15% lower by the end of the forecast period compared to the start.
